title: 第二十五章 将军梦也要实现了第二十六章 春日小聚冰山流泉
content_zh:
第二天，当赵嵘听说昨夜之事，特别是王昱请了孤桐紫玉前来做客，不禁呆滞了片刻，然后急匆匆的来到会客堂，才发现众人已经在吃早饭了。
互相见过之后，王昱请赵嵘入座，卫孤桐也说起了自己住进王府的意图。
“我夫妇闲云野鹤，居无定所，倒也习惯了，但带着霏霏，却有些不便。”
卫孤桐道，“霏霏家族覆灭，心情低落，不准备继续留在中原，她本意是报仇之后，也不回中原了，而是隐姓埋名远走西域。
据说西域连通中西，有大漠绿洲，三十六国和平共处，无论男女俱都能歌善舞，乃是人间善地，但我们来到陇山府打听了些，方知西域也是兵戈四起，自身难保。”
“不过好巧不巧，正好遇上了赵王爷。”言紫玉道，“赵王爷虽然脾气不小，但却真诚可靠，镇西王府也足以震慑宵小。
所以我们想将霏霏托付给赵王爷，让霏霏在镇西王府暂住一段时间，我夫妇足感盛情，若是有西北的才俊不嫌弃霏霏，我夫妇也有丰厚嫁妆送上。”
“婶婶。”袁霏霏呼吸急促，“我以后只愿孤独终老……”
“糊涂。”卫孤桐打断说道，“你若孤独终老，袁家的血脉便算是绝后了。”
袁霏霏不再说话，但眼神却很是倔强。
卫孤桐叹了口气，也不再勉强，只是看向王昱。
王昱自然没有意见，“卫前辈和言前辈信任镇西王府，那是小王的荣幸，就请袁姑娘在迎风阁住下，想住多久住多久，也为王府增些文雅之气，小王也有幸一听旷世名曲。”
“甚好甚好。”卫孤桐抚掌笑道，“霏霏年纪虽轻，但已得袁家真传，琴艺不凡，《冰山流泉》也是极为精湛的。”
言紫玉笑道，“那就多谢赵王爷了。”
……
江湖儿女，说走就走。
用过了早饭，卫孤桐和言紫玉便即告辞离开，王昱将自制的香水送了言紫玉三瓶，又收获了一波好感，然后赵英杰去收拾了迎风阁出来，袁霏霏便在镇西王府住下。
几天之后，千柳庄的后续事宜已经处理完毕，丁家分支将大量土地商铺卖给镇西王府，自己只留下了庄子和少量田产财富，再加上新家主武功不济，几乎可以说是退出武林了。
香水工坊的建设也很顺利，西北有种植的兰花、牡丹、桃花香水开始小范围产出，王府的商队已经带着成品香水前往中原，顺便采购中原种植的玫瑰、丁香、蔷薇等等。
此方世界毕竟不比现代，温室大棚控温之下各种花卉随时都能种植，只能等待天时，或者收购一些去年剩下的干花瓣。

王昱这几天也在继续练功，无论内力、轻功、剑法，俱有进益。
特别是赵嵘又采购到了一株百年野山参和一块老山黄精。
再一次，看到王昱像啃馒头一样将一株野山参和一株老黄精干掉，赵嵘嘴角抽搐。
是药三分毒，再是大补药物，这么干吃也不太合适吧？
他实在忍不住了，问王昱道，“要不要将李大夫给您把把脉？”
李大夫，王府内的医生，专门负责府内人员的生病医治工作。
“不用，我心里有数！”
王昱摆摆手，感受着体内经脉的拓展，内力越发的流畅，“嵘叔继续收购药材，特别是上百年的，或者对咱们武者也有用的大补药物。”
赵嵘，“……”
看到赵嵘不动，王昱问道，“嵘叔还有事？”
赵嵘点点头，“彭将军和陆将军，少爷已经见过了，如今王府已经稳定下来，您看要不要抽时间去北线，见见杨将军和冯将军。”
杨将军，杨天昭，扬威军统帅，坐镇陇山府北线金风关。
冯将军，冯敬，定安军统帅，坐镇庆安府北线灵武关。
镇西王毕竟是乃是马上封王，无论是创始人赵凌，还是王昱的假爹赵峥，都曾统帅各军，横扫漠北，割据一方。
所以将要知兵，王要知将。
杨天昭和冯敬坐镇北线，肯定是不能脱离军队前来王府拜见的，若是王昱不去北线，那就只能等到明年换防，他们两人再来拜见。
但如此一来，时间太久，更容易给人留下一个王爷不敢上前线的感觉，王不知将，那离衰落也就不远了。
“好啊！”王昱眼前一亮，立刻答应。
作为一个华夏男儿，除了有一个仗剑天下、行走江湖的武侠梦，自然也有一个封狼居胥、饮马瀚海的将军梦。
现代汉服复兴，总有人说男人对汉服没兴趣，而且也没什么好看的衣服，都是女人撑起汉服的半边天。

你给他一具明光铠，再给他一杆亮银枪试试？
须知在各地古装景区，回头率最高的不是各种各样漂亮的小姐姐，而是那些身着全套甲具，胯下战马，手持长兵的帅哥哥。
content_en:
The next day, when Zhao Rong heard about what happened last night, especially that Wang Yu invited Gutong Ziyu to come as a guest, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, and then hurried to the living room, only to find that everyone was already having breakfast.
After meeting each other, Wang Yu invited Zhao Rong to take a seat, and Wei Gutong also talked about his intention to live in the palace.
"My wife and I have no fixed place to live, so we are used to it, but taking Feifei with us is a bit inconvenient."
Wei Gutong said, "Feifei's family was destroyed and she was in a low mood. She was not prepared to stay in the Central Plains. Her original intention was not to return to the Central Plains after her revenge, but to go to the Western Regions incognito.
It is said that the Western Region connects China and the West, with desert oases, thirty-six countries coexisting peacefully, and both men and women singing and dancing. It is a good place in the world. However, when we came to Longshan Mansion to inquire more, we found out that the Western Region is also at war with each other and cannot protect itself. "
"But what a coincidence, I happened to meet Prince Zhao." Yan Ziyu said, "Although Prince Zhao has a bad temper, he is sincere and reliable, and the Zhenxi Prince's Palace is enough to intimidate Xiaoxiao.
So we want to entrust Feifei to Prince Zhao and let Feifei live temporarily in the Zhenxi Prince's Mansion for a while. My husband and I feel very gracious. If there are talents from the northwest who don't despise Feifei, my husband and I will also have a generous dowry to give. "
"Auntie." Yuan Feifei breathed rapidly, "I only want to die alone..."
"Confused." Wei Gutong interrupted, "If you die alone, the Yuan family's bloodline will be considered extinct."
Yuan Feifei stopped talking, but her eyes were very stubborn.
Wei Gutong sighed, no longer forced, and just looked at Wang Yu.
Wang Yu naturally had no objection, "Senior Wei and Senior Yan trust the Zhenxi Prince's Mansion. It is an honor for Xiao Wang, so he invites Miss Yuan to stay in Yingfeng Pavilion for as long as he likes. It will also add some elegance to the palace. Xiao Wang is also lucky enough to listen to famous music."
"Very good, very good." Wei Gutong said with a smile, stroking his palms, "Although Feifei is young, she has received the true inheritance from the Yuan family, and her piano skills are extraordinary. "Ice Mountain and Flowing Spring" is also extremely superb."
Yan Ziyu smiled and said, "Thank you so much, Prince Zhao."
…
The children of Jianghu can leave as soon as they say so.
After breakfast, Wei Gutong and Yan Ziyu said goodbye and left. Wang Yu gave three bottles of homemade perfume to Yan Ziyu, which gained another wave of goodwill. Then Zhao Yingjie went to clean up Yingfeng Pavilion and came out, and Yuan Feifei stayed at Zhenxi Prince's Mansion.
A few days later, the follow-up matters of Qianliu Village were completed. The Ding family branch sold a large amount of land and shops to Zhenxi Prince's Mansion, leaving only Zhuangzi and a small amount of land wealth. In addition, the new head of the family was not good at martial arts, and he could almost be said to have quit the martial arts.
The construction of the perfume workshop is also going very smoothly. Orchids, peonies, and peach blossom perfumes grown in the northwest have begun to be produced on a small scale. The royal palace's caravan has brought finished perfumes to the Central Plains, and by the way purchased roses, lilacs, roses, etc. grown in the Central Plains.
After all, this world is no different than modern times. All kinds of flowers can be planted at any time under the temperature control of greenhouses. You can only wait for the right time, or buy some dried flower petals left over from last year.
Wang Yu has also continued to practice in the past few days, and has improved in terms of internal strength, light skills, and swordsmanship.
In particular, Zhao Rong purchased a century-old wild ginseng and a piece of Laoshan Polygonatum.
Once again, Zhao Rong's mouth twitched when he saw Wang Yu eating up a wild ginseng and an old Huangjing plant like eating steamed buns.
It's a medicine that contains three parts of poison, and it's a tonic medicine. It's not appropriate to take it dry like this, right?
He couldn't bear it anymore and asked Wang Yu, "Do you want Dr. Li to take your pulse?"
Doctor Li, a doctor in the palace, is responsible for the treatment of illnesses of people in the palace.
"No, I know it well!"
Wang Yu waved his hand, feeling the expansion of the meridians in the body, and the internal energy became more and more fluid, "Uncle Rong continues to purchase medicinal materials, especially those that are hundreds of years old or are useful for us warriors."
Zhao Rong, "..."
Seeing that Zhao Rong was motionless, Wang Yu asked, "Uncle Rong, is there anything else?"
Zhao RongNodding, "Young Master has already met General Peng and General Lu. Now that the palace has stabilized, do you think you should take time to go to the Northern Front to meet General Yang and General Feng."
General Yang, Yang Tianzhao, commander-in-chief of the Yangwei Army, is stationed at Jinfeng Pass on the northern line of Longshan Prefecture.
General Feng, Feng Jing, commander-in-chief of the Ding'an Army, is stationed at Lingwuguan on the northern line of Qing'an Prefecture.
After all, the King of Zhenxi was immediately crowned king. Both the founder, Zhao Ling, and Wang Yu's fake father, Zhao Zheng, had commanded various armies, swept across Mobei, and established a separate empire.
Therefore, the general must know his troops, and the king must know his generals.
Yang Tianzhao and Feng Jing were stationed on the northern front, so they would definitely not be able to leave the army and come to the palace to pay their respects. If Wang Yu did not go to the northern front, they would have to wait until the defense changes next year and they would come to pay their respects again.
But in this way, if the time is too long, it will be easier to leave people with the feeling that the prince does not dare to go to the front line. If the king does not know the general, then he is not far from decline.
"Okay!" Wang Yu's eyes lit up and he agreed immediately.
As a Chinese man, in addition to having a martial arts dream of wielding a sword in the world and traveling around the world, he also naturally has a dream of being a general who sequesters wolves and lives in Xu, and drinks horses from the vast ocean.
With the revival of modern Hanfu, some people always say that men are not interested in Hanfu, and there are no good-looking clothes. Women hold up half of the sky of Hanfu.
You give him a bright light armor, and then give him a bright silver gun to try?
It should be noted that in various ancient costume scenic spots, the ones that turn heads the most are not the various beautiful ladies, but the handsome men wearing full armor, with war horses on their crotches, and long soldiers in their hands.
